messages:
nina_support: FYI we're seeing a sharp p99 spike on /v1/chat/generate since ~02:10 UTC. p95 jumped ~120ms -> ~650ms, p99 to ~2400ms. Started after last night's runtime rollout with ENABLE_FLASH_OPT=1. Mostly affects long contexts (>2048). Tickets: C-4821, C-4823.

tyler_oncall: on it. can you drop the alert graph and impacted model ids? link to traces/obs pls.

nina_support: traces/insights: https://console.redwood/investigations/4821. Top impacted: rwd-chat-13b, rwd-chat-7b. Hardware skew: majority on A100-40 (zone us-west1-b).

alex_k: did the kernel-selection heuristics change with this flag? I remember the flash path was made preferred for sdpa-ish ops. want runtime logs showing kernel choice.
deploy-bot: deploy jamie_m@2026-03-16T02:00Z completed. flags: ENABLE_FLASH_OPT=1, SDPA_FALLBACK_THRESHOLD=0.5, KERN_TUNE=v12.

maria_s: pasting a short runtime log sample we pulled from an affected host:

```
kernel_select: model=rwd-chat-13b seq_len=4096 batch=1 selected=flash_attn_v2 latency_ms=2100 fallback=false
kv_cache_op: hits=0 misses=1 eviction=0
runtime_warn: alignment_mismatch=false, simd_path=enabled
```

alex_k: 2.1s for that selection is suspicious — flash_attn shouldn't be that slow for single-token steps. Could be fallback into an unoptimized slow path (e.g., scalar fallback) due to a compile/ABI mismatch or alignment.

tyler_oncall: mitigation options: (1) rollback ENABLE_FLASH_OPT in canary first, (2) force kernel heuristic to prefer sdpa for seq_len>=2048, (3) pin high-latency customers to dedicated older-runtime pool. I can run a canary rollback now if we agree.

jamie_m: +1 to canary rollback first to limit blast radius. I'll stage rollback to the canary group in ~5m.

nina_support: I'll inform affected customers with a short note and offer a temporary SLA credit while we investigate.

alex_k: repro steps I used locally (quick):

1) export ENABLE_FLASH_OPT=1
2) run the microbench script with seq_len=4096 on an A100 image

```
# repro (condensed)
docker run --gpus all -e ENABLE_FLASH_OPT=1 redwood/runtime:canary /bench/run.sh --model rwd-chat-13b --seq 4096 --steps 200
```

Output showed token-step p99 ~1.9s and kernel_select consistently choosing flash_attn_v2. When I set FORCE_KERNEL=sdpa the latency dropped to ~140ms.

maria_s: created ENG-5123 to track this regression + added a perf test for seq_len distribution >2048. I'm also adding unit tests for kernel-selection heuristics and a quick guard that forces sdpa for very long sequences until we root-cause.

tyler_oncall: rollback update: canary rollback applied at 03:05Z. Observability shows canary p99 down to ~180ms within 3 minutes. Holding for 10m to watch for regressions before rolling fleet-wide.

jamie_m: will coordinate a controlled fleet rollback if canary stays green. also adding a temporary feature-flag gate so ENABLE_FLASH_OPT is off by default for models with seq_len_hist>2048.

nina_support: customers notified (C-4821/C-4823) with brief summary + ETA. collecting any customer logs for repro.

alex_k: next steps from infra/research side: capture the exact kernel build artifacts from the canary image and compare compiler flags (AVX, cuda arch) vs fleet. I suspect a compile-time mismatch produced a slow codepath.

maria_s: agreed — I'll fetch build metadata from CI and diff compile flags. adding postmortem template and timeline to ENG-5123.

tyler_oncall: status: canary stable for 18m, rolling to fleet in 8m with emergency rollback plan. will update once fleet roll starts.

nina_support: thanks all — closing loop once fleet roll completes and customers ack. :eyes:
